dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Katheryne, it's you again!

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hello, it is indeed me, Katheryne, the receptionist of the Adventurers' Guild. My job is to provide the adventurers with quests and intelligence support.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Since it looks like you're already familiar with the Adventurers' Guild's modus operandi, I'll leave it at that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Farewell, Adventurer, and thank you for supporting the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you been following me this whole time?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hehe, if all expenses are covered, I won't refuse.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: But unfortunately, being a receptionist is a year-round job, so I don't get vacation opportunities like that.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Claim Adventure Rank Rewards

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Claim Adventure Rank Rewards</color>

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are you feeling now, Katheryne?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: How am I feeling? ...Was I unwell?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but I'm afraid that I can't quite remember what happened before... But since I'm here, I suppose it was no trouble in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (So Katheryne doesn't remember... Has the previous puppet been replaced?)

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Check Valiant Chronicles information

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Check Valiant Chronicles information</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild, My Lady. Is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Farewell, My Lady, and thank you for supporting the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Have you any awesome commissions for me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You've come at just the right time. I have a handbook that the Guild would like to present to veteran adventurers such as yourself.

choices.text: Could it be the Official Teyvat Cookbook?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: As you can see, this handbook contains information on powerful enemies worth facing.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If you can make good use of it, I'm sure it will be of great help in your adventures. Of course, you're welcome to come back anytime if you need to check on any relevant information.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I wish you success in your endeavors!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: It's up to you whether you wish to take on the challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Claim Daily Commission Reward

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I am sorry, but you have not yet completed enough commissions.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Claim Daily Commission Reward</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Thank you for completing today's commissions. Here is your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: <color=#999999FF>Claim Daily Commission Reward</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You have already claimed today's reward. Please come back for more commissions tomorrow!

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Dispatch Character on Expedition

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Dispatch Character on Expedition</color>
